description: This file contains localization (i18n) strings and functions for the Select2 plugin in the Khmer (km) language, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines error messages, prompts, and other UI text to be used by the plugin for Khmer language support.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message shown when data loading fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to delete excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to input more characters when input is below the minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while additional data is being fetched.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while a search is in progress.
